name: Rank-Three Square Completion
definition: Use the rank-zero, rank-one, and rank-two Hamming balls on each of two private two-cubes as the two maximum triples in the opposite-triple square construction.
properties: The four visible square sections have sizes $4,9,4,1$, so the completed class has 18 words on six coordinates. The explicit construction gives a rank-three maximum parent with $\sum_{i=0}^3\binom8i=93$ words on eight coordinates.
